liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Deal** (1 review): Jerry Garcia's guitar performance on Deal and Brown Eyed Women is highlighted [8]
- **Sittin' On Top Of The World** (1 review): The transition from Dark Star Jam to Sittin' On Top Of The World is sweet [11]
- **Dark Star Jam** (1 review): Transitions into Me and My Uncle and back are described as smooth then abrupt [6]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-12-05.131532.miller.sbd.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 33 songs; 212 min; rated 4.44/5 by 9 [1]
- **gd1971-12-05.fm.matera.100316.sbeok.flac16**: FM broadcast; 34 songs; 205 min; rated 4.92/5 by 13 [2]
- **gd71-12-05.prefm.miller.3391.sbeok.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 31 songs; 184 min; rated 4.58/5 by 33 [5]. Said about its sound: Mix is clear but slightly airy and not fully cleaned up, rated near-perfect; Audio is somewhat compressed and muddy, though still considered very listenable; Sound is conditioned to FCC specifications for radio broadcast [7][11][14]
- **gd1971-12-05.147715.sbd.flegel-unknown.flac16**: soundboard; 34 songs; 192 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Bill Graham [1]
- Bill Graham introduced Jerry Garcia as the Godfather of Rock n Roll [8]
- First winter concerts at Madison Square Garden after Filmore East closed [14]
- NRPS was the opening act, and DJ Pat Dawson hosted the broadcast [17]
- China Cat licks appear in Tennessee Jed, Me and Bobby McGee, and Goin' Down The Road [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-12-05.131532.miller.sbd.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat [1]
- **gd1971-12-05.fm.matera.100316.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Don Rohde; transferred by Phil Matera; source: FM -> Master Reel [2]. Also: Missing pieces were spliced from a circulating pre-FM recording [2]
- **gd71-12-05.prefm.miller.3391.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]
- **gd1971-12-05.147715.sbd.flegel-unknown.flac16**: source: Patched, retracked by Brian Flegel [3]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by albamusic.hu: [GRATEFUL DEAD – Felt Forum (Madison Square Garden, New York, December 5 1971, WNEW Broadcast) (3CD) (2022) – AlbaMusic](https://albamusic.hu/termek/grateful-dead-felt-forum-madison-square-garden-new-york-december-5-1971-wnew-broadcast-3cd-2022/) [19]
- Poster by Crash Records: [Grateful Dead - Felt Forum, Madison Square Garden. New York, December 5 1971 WNEW Broadcast](https://www.crashrecords.co.uk/products/grateful-dead-felt-forum-madison-square-garden-new-york-december-5-1971-wnew-broadcast-pre-order) [20]
- Poster by tralfaz-archives.com: [Cover Art: Grateful Dead - Live At The Felt Forum 12/5/1971](https://tralfaz-archives.com/coverart/G/Grateful_Dead/gdead_gdead_live.html) [21]
